import java.util.*;
public class MEanInequality {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in);
		int t=sc.nextInt();
		while(t-->0) {
			int n=sc.nextInt();
			int a[]=new int[2*n];
			for(int i=0;i<2*n;i++)
				a[i]=sc.nextInt();
			Arrays.sort(a);
			for(int i=0;i<n;i++) {
				System.out.print(a[i]+" ");
				System.out.print(a[n+i]+" ");
			}
			System.out.println();
		}
	}

}
